speaker.input: Pre-Med Society panel with 150 attendees and two guest speakers from UCSF, Tuesday 5-7pm. We need mics and a projector.

ambiguities.question: Will food or refreshments be served at the panel?

writer.headline: Staff review required — briefing prepared
writer.explanation: Your reservation requires staff review before confirmation because the expected attendance of 150 participants exceeds the threshold for large events and the event welcomes non-SFSU guests. Additionally, external guest speakers must be registered with Student Activities & Events, and confirmation is needed regarding whether any food or beverages will be provided in Business Building 120.
writer.permitNarrative: Pre-Med Society is hosting a career-focused panel discussion featuring visiting medical professionals in Business Building 120. The event will run for two hours, welcoming up to 150 campus and community members with microphone and projection support.

briefing.summary: Pre-Med Society has requested Business Building 120 on October 6, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM for a speaker panel of 150 attendees. While the venue fits the fire capacity, the presence of outside attendees, guest speakers, and crowd scale requires administrative coordination.

riskPoints.point: The expected attendance of 150 exceeds the 100-attendee mark, requiring staff assessment for crowd flow, accessibility, and facility supervision.
Attendance is open to individuals not affiliated with SFSU, requiring a campus safety review before the reservation can proceed.
External guest speakers must be identified and registered with Student Activities & Events.
The organizer has not yet confirmed whether food or refreshments will be present, which is restricted in classroom facilities.

staffQuestions: Can the organizer provide the names and affiliations of the invited guest speakers?
Will any food or beverages be provided during the event?
What check-in and crowd management procedures are planned for non-university attendees?

dance.input: Dance practice for 25 of our members Thursday 9:30-11pm at the Village community room, we'll bring a speaker for music.

writer.headline: Almost there — switch to a sound-isolated space for late-night rehearsal
writer.explanation: Your dance practice fits well within campus capacity and scheduling guidelines, but the Village Community Room cannot host amplified sound after 8:00 PM due to residential quiet hours and general late-night sound restrictions after 9:00 PM. Relocating your reservation to Gymnasium 129 resolves both sound policy conflicts while accommodating your group size and schedule. No additional permits are required.
